task.label_source: BigEarthNet v2 CLC2018 v2020_u1 patch labels
task.why: The same target can measure real standalone utility from the optical and SAR branches without forcing language generation or claiming fusion.
task.threshold_policy: Any decision thresholds are selected on validation only and frozen before a one-time test evaluation.

outer_split.policy: Retain official BigEarthNet v2 train/validation/test assignments exactly.
outer_split.test_usage: Select and checksum the test subset with the same deterministic algorithm, then keep labels unavailable to training/tuning code until the final frozen evaluation.

proposed_targets.count_tolerance: A split may exceed its target by at most one indivisible geographic group's size; geographic integrity wins over an exact row count.

geographic_group.key: MGRS tile ID + horizontal patch position + vertical patch position parsed from patch_id
geographic_group.purpose: Keep repeat acquisitions of the same 1200 m cell together and make the grouping auditable.
validation: Fail if a patch_id cannot be parsed by the documented BigEarthNet v2 naming grammar.
Fail if a geographic group appears in more than one official split.
Fail if patch_id or s1_name is duplicated with conflicting metadata.
Retain the official split even if a custom group assertion fails; stop preparation rather than silently repair it.
geographic_group.adjacent_tile_policy: Rely on the official v2 frame split for adjacent-tile overlap control; do not create a second split assignment.

algorithm: Read and checksum metadata.parquet; sort every list and row using Unicode code-point ordering before hashing.
Apply eligibility rules and form indivisible geographic groups separately inside each official split.
Calculate split-local targets for all 19 labels and countries from the eligible official split distribution.
Greedily select the group that most reduces weighted squared deviation from label and country targets; weight labels by inverse eligible frequency.
Break every tie by ascending SHA-256 of seed_material, official split, and geographic_group key.
After distribution targets are met, fill toward the pair target by the same hash order without splitting a geographic group.
Sort final samples by split then patch_id and serialize canonical UTF-8 JSON with sorted object keys and no volatile timestamp.

coverage_assertions.country_coverage: Every country represented in an eligible official split must remain represented in that selected split.
coverage_assertions.fallback: If an assertion cannot be met at the proposed size, fail and report availability; do not borrow from another official split or silently enlarge the selection.

frozen_manifest_schema.reproducibility: The experiment-definition manifest contains no created_at field and is never rewritten by data download. Volatile paths, per-file hashes discovered during extraction, and timestamps live in a separate materialization sidecar.
frozen_manifest_schema.manifest_hash: SHA-256 of canonical JSON bytes after selection; used by training and resume guards.

experiment_sequence: Frozen CROMA optical encoder plus a trainable linear 19-label head.
Frozen CROMA SAR encoder plus a trainable linear 19-label head.
One parameter-efficient adaptation configuration selected using training and validation only; no joint/fusion mode in Phase 4.

storage_estimate.recommended_working_capacity_gib: 8-12 GiB for selected extracted GeoTIFFs, manifests, cache, and the 0.72 GiB base checkpoint
storage_estimate.transfer_warning: The official imagery is distributed as monolithic tar.zst archives. Until an official selective-access method is verified, materializing this subset may still require transferring the full 109.61 GiB S1+S2 archives.

not_performed: No imagery or checkpoint was downloaded.
No training or evaluation was run.
